field_rect.brief: 计算地址栏输入框的矩形 / Compute the address-field rectangle

params.engine: 引擎实例，提供窗口宽度 / Engine instance, supplies the window width

field_rect.return: 输入框在设备坐标下的矩形 / The field rectangle in device coordinates
field_rect.note: 横向居中留边，纵向固定为窗口顶部条带内 / Padded horizontally and placed in the fixed strip at the top

addr_layout.brief: 一次性解析绘制与命中测试所需的几何 / Resolve the geometry the painter and hit testing need in one pass

params.L: out:接收排版结果的布局结构 / Layout struct that receives the result

addr_layout.return: 可用返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when usable, otherwise 0

retval.1: 已填好字段、字体、基线、文本宽度 / Field, font, baseline and text width are filled in
retval.0: 无地址栏、无字体或文本视口过窄 / No chrome, no font, or the text viewport is too narrow

addr_layout.note: 失败时 `L` 被清零，调用方须据此放弃绘制 / On failure `L` is zeroed and the caller must skip layout-dependent work

addr_width_to.brief: 求文本前 `index` 字节的步进宽度 / Measure the advance width of the first `index` bytes of the text

params.font: 用于测量的字体 / Font used for measuring
params.len: 文本总字节数 / Total text length in bytes
params.index: 要累加到哪个字节偏移（夹到 `len`）/ Byte offset to accumulate up to, clamped to `len`

addr_width_to.return: 前缀的步进宽度（像素）/ Advance width of the prefix in pixels
addr_width_to.note: 按码点逐个累加，与 `hpe_font_measure` 在任意前缀上一致 / Sums code point by code point, matching `hpe_font_measure` on every prefix

addr_index_at.brief: 求最接近设备 x 的插入符字节偏移 / Find the caret byte offset closest to a device x

params.engine: 引擎实例，提供地址文本与滚动量 / Engine instance, provides the address text and scroll offset

addr_index_at.return: 插入符所在字节偏移 / Byte offset of the caret position
addr_index_at.note: 以字形步进的一半为界判断归属左半还是右半 / Decides by the midpoint of each glyph advance

addr_clamp_scroll.brief: 让插入符保持在输入框可视范围内 / Keep the caret inside the field's viewport

params.engine: 引擎实例，读写 `addr_scroll` / Engine instance, reads and writes `addr_scroll`

addr_clamp_scroll.note: 失焦时改为显示地址尾部（浏览器行为）；拖过边缘与在末尾输入都靠它滚动 / A blurred field shows the tail of the address (browser behaviour); this is what scrolls on drag-past-edge and typing at the end

addr_sel_start.brief: 取选区起始字节偏移 / Get the selection's start byte offset
addr_sel_start.return: 锚点与插入符中较小者 / The smaller of anchor and caret

addr_sel_end.brief: 取选区结束字节偏移 / Get the selection's end byte offset
addr_sel_end.return: 锚点与插入符中较大者 / The larger of anchor and caret

addr_has_selection.brief: 判断是否存在选区 / Test whether there is a selection
addr_has_selection.return: 锚点与插入符不同返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when anchor differs from caret, otherwise 0

addr_set_caret.brief: 把插入符移到指定字节偏移 / Move the caret to a byte offset

params.index: 目标字节偏移，夹到 `[0, addr_len]` / Target byte offset, clamped to `[0, addr_len]`
params.extend: 非零时保留锚点以扩展选区 / Non-zero keeps the anchor to extend the selection

addr_prev_index.brief: 求前一个码点的起始字节偏移 / Find the byte offset of the previous code point

params.i: 当前字节偏移 / Current byte offset

addr_prev_index.return: 前一个码点起点，已在开头时返回 0 / The previous code point's start, 0 when already at the beginning

addr_next_index.brief: 求后一个码点的起始字节偏移 / Find the byte offset of the next code point

params.i: 当前字节偏移 / Current byte offset
params.len: 文本总字节数 / Total text length in bytes

addr_next_index.return: 后一个码点起点，已到末尾时返回 `len` / The next code point's start, `len` when already at the end
addr_next_index.note: 解码失败时至少前进 1 字节，保证循环收敛 / Advances at least one byte on a decode failure so loops terminate

cp_at.brief: 取某字节偏移处的码点 / Read the code point at a byte offset
cp_at.return: 该处码点；越界或已到 NUL 时返回 0 / The code point there, 0 when out of range or at the NUL

is_word_cp.brief: 判断码点是否属于单词 / Test whether a code point counts as part of a word

params.cp: Unicode 码点 / Unicode code point

is_word_cp.return: 属于单词返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when it is part of a word, otherwise 0
is_word_cp.note: ASCII 字母数字、`_` 以及任意非 ASCII 码点都算单词，使中文路径段成为一整词，与 Chrome 的选词一致 / ASCII alphanumerics, `_` and any non-ASCII code point count as a word, so a Chinese path segment is one word like Chrome's word selection

addr_word_left.brief: 求左侧单词边界 / Find the word boundary to the left

params.i: 起始字节偏移 / Starting byte offset

addr_word_left.return: 向左跨过一个单词后的字节偏移 / Byte offset after moving left across one word
addr_word_left.note: 先跳过单词前的分隔符，再跨过单词本身 / Skips the delimiters before the word, then the word itself

addr_word_right.brief: 求右侧单词边界 / Find the word boundary to the right

params.len: 文本总字节数 / Total text length in bytes
params.i: 起始字节偏移 / Starting byte offset

addr_word_right.return: 向右跨过一个单词后的字节偏移 / Byte offset after moving right across one word
addr_word_right.note: 先跳过单词后的分隔符，再跨过单词本身 / Skips the delimiters after the word, then the word itself

addr_word_at.brief: 求某偏移两侧同类码点的连续区间 / Find the run of same-class code points around an offset

params.len: 文本总字节数 / Total text length in bytes
params.i: 目标字节偏移 / Target byte offset
params.out_a: out:区间起始字节偏移 / Start byte offset of the run
params.out_b: out:区间结束字节偏移 / End byte offset of the run

addr_word_at.note: 供双击选词使用；空文本时两个输出都为 0 / Used for double-click word selection; both outputs are 0 for empty text

hpe_chrome_set_text.brief: 替换地址栏文本并把插入符移到末尾 / Replace the address-bar text and put the caret at the end

params.engine: 引擎实例，NULL 时直接返回 / Engine instance, returns early when NULL
params.text: 新文本，NULL 视为空串 / New text, NULL is treated as an empty string

hpe_chrome_set_text.note: 同时记录为 `addr_committed`，即按 Escape 时回退到的地址；超长则按缓冲容量截断 / Also stored as `addr_committed`, the address Escape falls back to; longer input is truncated to the buffer capacity

addr_delete_range.brief: 删除字节区间并把插入符移到区间起点 / Delete a byte range and put the caret at its start

params.a: 区间起始字节偏移 / Start byte offset
params.b: 区间结束字节偏移 / End byte offset

addr_delete_range.return: 实际删除返回 1，区间为空或越界返回 0 / 1 when something was removed, 0 for an empty or out-of-range span

addr_delete_selection.brief: 删除当前选区 / Delete the current selection
addr_delete_selection.return: 删除了内容返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when something was removed, otherwise 0

addr_insert_at_caret.brief: 在插入符处插入文本并替换选区 / Insert text at the caret, replacing the selection

params.text: 待插入的 UTF-8 文本 / UTF-8 text to insert
params.len: 待插入的字节数 / Number of bytes to insert

addr_insert_at_caret.return: 插入成功返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when inserted, otherwise 0

retval.1: 文本已写入，插入符停在插入内容之后 / The text was written and the caret sits after it
retval.0: 无输入或缓冲已满 / No input or the buffer is full

addr_insert_at_caret.note: 缓冲写满时按码点边界截断，绝不切断 UTF-8 序列 / Truncates on a code point boundary when the buffer is full, never splitting a UTF-8 sequence

sanitize_paste.brief: 清洗粘贴文本中的控制字符与首尾空白 / Sanitise pasted text of control characters and surrounding blanks

params.src: 原始粘贴文本 / Raw pasted text

sanitize_paste.return: 清洗后的新缓冲区，调用方负责释放 / The cleaned buffer, owned by the caller
sanitize_paste.note: 剪贴板常带结尾换行，多行拷贝也不能把换行偷偷带进路径，因此丢弃换行、制表符等控制字符并去除首尾空格 / Clipboards often carry a trailing newline and multi-line copies must not smuggle a newline into a path, so line breaks, tabs and other control characters are dropped and surrounding spaces trimmed

addr_paste.brief: 粘贴剪贴板文本到插入符处 / Paste clipboard text at the caret
addr_paste.return: 插入了内容返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when something was inserted, otherwise 0
addr_paste.note: 先经 `sanitize_paste` 清洗再插入 / Cleans the text through `sanitize_paste` before inserting

addr_copy.brief: 复制或剪切选区到剪贴板 / Copy or cut the selection to the clipboard

params.cut: 非零表示剪切 / Non-zero means cut instead of copy

addr_copy.return: 写入了剪贴板或执行了剪切返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when the clipboard was written or a cut happened, otherwise 0
addr_copy.note: 无选区时 Ctrl+C 复制整条地址（剪切则不做任何事），与 Chrome 一致 / With no selection Ctrl+C copies the whole address (cut does nothing), matching Chrome

draw_run.brief: 在基线上绘制一段文本 / Draw one text run on the baseline

params.pm: 目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.text: 待绘制的 UTF-8 文本 / UTF-8 text to draw
params.len: 文本字节数 / Number of bytes
params.x: 绘制起点 X（设备坐标）/ Starting X in device coordinates
params.baseline: 文本基线的设备 Y 坐标 / Device Y of the text baseline

draw_run.note: 取覆盖率掩码后调用 `hpe_draw_text_mask` 混合；空段或取掩码失败时直接返回 / Fetches the coverage mask and blends via `hpe_draw_text_mask`; returns early for an empty run or a failed mask

chrome_paint_field_text.brief: 绘制输入框文本（占位提示或选区加文本）/ Paint the field's text, either the hint or the selection plus runs

params.pm: 目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.text_color: 正文颜色 / Body text colour
params.hint_color: 占位提示颜色 / Placeholder hint colour
params.sel_bg: 选区背景色 / Selection background colour
params.sel_fg: 选区前景色 / Selection foreground colour

chrome_paint_field_text.note: 失焦时不画高亮；有选区时先画高亮圆角矩形，再把选区画成 `sel_fg` 以保持字形清晰，两侧各画一段 `text_color` / An unfocused field shows no highlight; with a selection it paints the highlight rounded rect first, then the selected run in `sel_fg` so the glyphs stay crisp, flanked by two `text_color` runs

chrome_paint_caret.brief: 在插入点绘制插入符 / Paint the caret at the insertion point

params.pm: 目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer

chrome_paint_caret.note: 有选区或未聚焦时不绘制（与 Chrome 一致）；插入符位置夹在文本视口内 / Not drawn when there is a selection or the field is unfocused (matching Chrome); the position is clamped to the text viewport

hpe_chrome_paint.brief: 绘制整条地址栏 / Paint the whole address bar

params.engine: 引擎实例，NULL 或无地址栏时直接返回 / Engine instance, returns early when NULL or without chrome

hpe_chrome_paint.note: 先铺条带背景与 1 像素分隔线，再画带聚焦描边的圆角输入框，最后裁剪到文本视口绘制文本与插入符 / Paints the strip background and a 1 px separator, then the rounded field with its focus outline, then clips to the text viewport to paint the text and caret

addr_press.brief: 处理输入框内的一次按下 / Handle one press inside the field

params.x: 按下的 X 坐标（设备坐标）/ X position of the press in device coordinates

addr_press.note: 统计单击/双击/三击并决定选区：首次点击全选，Shift+点击移动选区末端，双击选词，三击全选；同时记录拖拽起点 / Counts single/double/triple clicks and picks the selection: the first click selects all, Shift+click moves the selection end, double click selects a word, triple click selects all; also records the drag origin

hpe_chrome_mouse.brief: 把一次鼠标事件喂给地址栏 / Feed one mouse event to the address bar

params.x: X 坐标（设备坐标）/ X position in device coordinates
params.y: Y 坐标（设备坐标）/ Y position in device coordinates
params.down: 按下为 1、抬起为 0 / 1 when pressed, 0 when released

hpe_chrome_mouse.return: 事件被地址栏消费返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when the bar consumed the event, otherwise 0
hpe_chrome_mouse.note: y 落在条带之外一律返回 0，交给页面处理；按下时根据是否落在输入框内决定聚焦或失焦 / Returns 0 for any y outside the strip so the page handles it; on press, focus or blur is decided by whether the point is inside the field

hpe_chrome_mouse_move.brief: 把指针移动喂给地址栏以拖选 / Feed a pointer move to the address bar for drag selection

params.x: X 坐标（设备坐标）/ X position in device coordinates
params.y: Y 坐标（设备坐标，仅作接口占位）/ Y position in device coordinates, used only for the interface signature

hpe_chrome_mouse_move.return: 选区发生变化返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when the selection changed, otherwise 0
hpe_chrome_mouse_move.note: 移动超过拖拽阈值后按下点才成为锚点，因此从全选状态拖拽会转为普通区间选择 / The press point becomes the anchor only after the pointer travels past the drag threshold, so dragging from a select-all turns into an ordinary range selection

normalize_input.brief: 规范化地址栏输入 / Normalise address-bar input

params.s: inout:就地修改的输入文本 / Input text modified in place

normalize_input.note: 去掉首尾空白、成对的引号以及可选的 `file://` 前缀（`file:///C:/...` 归一为 `C:/...`）/ Strips surrounding whitespace, a matching pair of quotes and an optional `file://` prefix (`file:///C:/...` becomes `C:/...`)

hpe_chrome_navigate.brief: 按地址栏内容导航 / Navigate using the address-bar contents

params.engine: 引擎实例，NULL 时返回 0 / Engine instance, returns 0 when NULL

hpe_chrome_navigate.return: 加载成功返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when the load succeeded, otherwise 0

retval.1: 已加载目标文件，或输入为空时加载空白页 / The target file was loaded, or a blank page when the input was empty
retval.0: 加载失败，地址文本保留以便用户修正 / The load failed; the typed text is kept so the user can fix it

hpe_chrome_navigate.note: 失败时错误已写入状态行（显示在窗口标题中），本函数只把状态标为需重绘 / On failure the error already lives in the status line (shown in the window title), so this only marks the chrome dirty

hpe_engine_key.brief: 发送一个无修饰键的按键 / Send one key stroke with no modifier

params.key: 按键码或码点 / Key code or code point

hpe_engine_key.note: 等价于修饰键掩码为 0 的调用 / Equivalent to calling with a zero modifier mask

addr_key_delete.brief: 处理退格与删除键 / Handle the Backspace and Delete keys

params.ctrl: 非零时按单词删除 / Non-zero deletes by word

addr_key_delete.return: 地址内容改变返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when the address changed, otherwise 0
addr_key_delete.note: 有选区时先删选区，否则删插入符两侧的字符或单词 / Deletes the selection first when there is one, otherwise the character or word on either side of the caret

addr_key_move.brief: 处理左右与行首行尾键 / Handle the Left, Right, Home and End keys

params.ctrl: 非零时按单词移动 / Non-zero moves by word
params.shift: 非零时扩展选区而非折叠 / Non-zero extends the selection instead of collapsing it

addr_key_move.note: 不带 Shift 且已有选区时，左右键折叠到选区相应端点 / Without Shift and with a selection, Left/Right collapse to the respective selection end

addr_key_edit.brief: 按键处理中的编辑部分 / The editing half of key handling

params.key: 按键码或码点 / Key code or code point
params.ctrl: Control 按下为 1 / 1 when Control is held
params.shift: Shift 按下为 1 / 1 when Shift is held

addr_key_edit.return: 地址内容改变返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when the address changed, otherwise 0
addr_key_edit.note: 分发退格/删除、移动、全选、复制/剪切/粘贴；其余可打印码点直接插入 / Dispatches Backspace/Delete, movement, select-all, copy/cut/paste; any other printable code point is inserted directly

hpe_engine_key_mods.brief: 带修饰键地把按键送给地址栏 / Send a key stroke with modifiers to the address bar

params.key: 按键码或码点 / Key code or code point

hpe_engine_key_mods.return: 按键被地址栏消费返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when the bar consumed the key, otherwise 0
hpe_engine_key_mods.note: 回车触发导航并保持聚焦；Escape 回退到获得焦点时的地址（`addr_committed`）后失焦；其余交给编辑逻辑处理 / Return triggers navigation and keeps focus; Escape restores the address the field got focus with (`addr_committed`) and blurs; the rest goes through the editing logic

hpe_engine_enable_chrome.brief: 为引擎启用自绘地址栏 / Enable the engine's self-drawn address bar

params.engine: 引擎实例，NULL 或已启用时直接返回 / Engine instance, returns early when NULL or already enabled

hpe_engine_enable_chrome.note: 启用后视口变窄：已排版则重排以重新夹紧滚动，否则标记整帧重绘 / Enabling narrows the viewport: a laid-out document is relaid to re-clamp the scroll, otherwise the whole frame is marked dirty

hpe_engine_chrome_height.brief: 取地址栏高度 / Get the address-bar height
hpe_engine_chrome_height.return: 地址栏高度（像素），未启用时为 0 / Address-bar height in pixels, 0 when disabled

hpe_engine_address_text.brief: 取地址栏当前文本 / Get the address bar's current text
hpe_engine_address_text.return: 地址文本，`engine` 为 NULL 时返回空串 / The address text, an empty string when `engine` is NULL

hpe_engine_address_focused.brief: 查询地址栏是否获得焦点 / Query whether the address bar is focused
hpe_engine_address_focused.return: 聚焦返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when focused, otherwise 0

hpe_engine_address_caret.brief: 取插入符字节偏移 / Get the caret's byte offset
hpe_engine_address_caret.return: 插入符字节偏移，`engine` 为 NULL 时返回 0 / Caret byte offset, 0 when `engine` is NULL

hpe_engine_address_selection.brief: 取地址栏选区范围 / Get the address bar's selection range

params.start: out:接收选区起始字节偏移，可为 NULL / Receives the selection start byte offset, may be NULL
params.end: out:接收选区结束字节偏移，可为 NULL / Receives the selection end byte offset, may be NULL

hpe_engine_address_selection.return: 有选区返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when there is a selection, otherwise 0
hpe_engine_address_selection.note: 无选区时不写出任何输出 / Writes no output when there is no selection
